sections.heading: Compliance Mandate
sections.body: CyberDyne Systems requires certification readiness across ISO 27001:2022, PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2 Type II within a single program.

sections.heading: Program Timeline
sections.body:
All three frameworks must reach audit-ready state within 4 months of kickoff.
External certification audits occur in month five.

sections.heading: Liquidated Damages
sections.body:
For every week of delay beyond the agreed milestones, the vendor shall pay liquidated damages of 2 percent of total contract value.
Cumulative liability is capped at 100 percent of contract value.

sections.heading: Liability And Indemnity
sections.body:
Vendor liability cap is unlimited for data-related claims.
Client liability is capped at fees paid in the preceding two months.

sections.heading: Governance
sections.body:
Weekly steering committee attendance is mandatory with senior leadership presence.
Queries to grc@cyberdyne-fictional.example.
